# Chapter 11 – False Ice

Scene 1. The team returns with weak results. Some crew begin arguing that the landing site itself may have been a fatal compromise.

Scene 2. Elena shuts down blame and orders a broader survey.

Scene 3. Mei explains to Gabriel that good science can still produce bad outcomes when the question is survival.

Scene 4. Tomas reassigns more robots to prospecting, angering Jonah, who needs them for habitat build-out.

Scene 5. A second site lights up with stronger signatures
